terms.gloss: the stag beetle: the zoologists’ name
evidence: Wikipedia, s.v. Lucanus cervus: “European stag beetle”
terms.comment: Linnaeus described it in 1758 as scarabaeus cervus. Pliny (NH 11.97) says Nigidius called these beetles lucavos or lucanos (the manuscripts differ); lucanus is not in Lewis & Short and is left without marks of length.

sources: Wikipedia, “Lucanus cervus”, read in a Kiwix copy of February 2024.
Pliny, Naturalis Historia, ed. Mayhoff (Teubner, 1906), read in the Perseus Digital Library.
